Vex|mid.identity: Magic damage burst mage, the nightmare of mobile champions. Her passive Doom 'n Gloom charges up regularly: when charged, her next ability fears and interrupts dashes; enemies who dash near her are marked (Gloom) for bonus damage. Mistral Bolt (Q) sends a wave that speeds up, Personal Space (W) gives a shield and strikes around her, Looming Darkness (E) slows in an area and marks, and Shadow Surge (R) marks a champion, then lets her dash to them (reset on takedown).
Vex|mid.playstyle: Anti-assassin, anti-mobility mage: she punishes every champion who dashes (Yone, Irelia, Sylas, Akali, LeBlanc, Yasuo).
Vex|mid.early_game: Poke with Q and E. Watch your passive: when it's charged, save it for the enemy engage (W the moment the assassin arrives = fear and interrupt). Mark enemies with E for bonus damage.
Vex|mid.level_1: Looming Darkness (E) first. Area poke and marks.
Vex|mid.level_2: Mistral Bolt (Q). E → Q: bonus damage on the marked target.
Vex|mid.level_3: Personal Space (W). A shield and a fear with your passive charged: your defensive tool against assassins.
Vex|mid.level_6: Shadow Surge: marks a champion, then dash to them for a big burst. A takedown resets your ultimate: chain targets in teamfights.
power_spikes: Level 6: burst and chase with R.
First completed item: one-shots on assassins.
Mid game: chained ultimates in teamfights.
Vex|mid.lane_plan: Poke with E and Q, keep your passive charged for engages. Push, then roam with your ultimate. The mid role quest (faster recall) makes your roams more profitable. Against assassins, let them come: your passive punishes them.
Vex|mid.trading: Short trade: E → Q. All-in: R → dash → W (passive charged) → E → Q. Defense: W the moment the enemy dashes. Give up on it against champions who poke you without dashing (Vladimir, Annie).
threats: Champions with no dash who poke you or heal (Vladimir, Annie).
Mid Nasus, who soaks your burst.
mistakes: Using your charged passive on a minion instead of the enemy engage.
Casting R when you can't kill the target.
Forgetting that your passive marks champions who dash.

matchup_notes.Yasuo: His E is a dash: he gets marked and your passive interrupts his engages.
matchup_notes.LeBlanc: Her W is a dash: keep your passive charged for her.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Her ultimate triggers your Gloom: W when she arrives.
matchup_notes.Yone: His E and Q3 are dashes: punish them.
matchup_notes.Vladimir: He has no dash to punish and heals: poke and play for objectives.

Vex|mid.mid_game: Roams with your ultimate, picks on assassins and objectives.
Vex|mid.late_game: Keep your passive charged for the enemy diver, then chain ultimates on low targets.
Vex|mid.ahead: Roam, hunt the carries and take objectives.
Vex|mid.behind: Farm and protect your team against assassins.
Vex|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to punish mobile champions with your passive and chain ultimates in teamfights.
Vex|mid.final_tip: Keep your passive charged for the moment your opponent dashes onto you: the fear turns the fight.
